summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K on 2026-11-05 carrying a press release (26-27-TR) announcing the release of its North America Truth and Reconciliation Action Plan, framing measurable commitments to Indigenous priorities and relationship-building across its operating regions. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is disclosed; the item is a corporate social-policy disclosure, the equivalent of a US voluntary ESG/community-relations press release furnished on Form 6-K. Nothing here is deal-related; no risk-arb angle exists and no capital-structure or ownership consequence follows from the announcement.
